g.text: RTX PRO 6000, one process, median of 3 alternating rounds (CUPTI). E1 is a test build of the FP8 mode with the FP4 -> FP8 conversion replaced

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: by two logic ops per word: wrong results, same control flow. Removing 40% of the instructions saves 12% at 64K; the rest of the gap is the kernel's serial chain.
